**S31 (25.8 s)**
Scores: emotion/story 2 · understood with sound off 3 · pacing 2 · composition 3

1. **4.2 s, late cue.** "your bar" is still missing at 2.58 s, which is fine, but the beam stays a grey dashed box until the end of the scene. Fix: when "printed on the paperwork" lands (6.5 s), slide a small paper sheet into the slot and lift the beam off it to a height.
2. **8.1–13.4 s, the stack does nothing.** The stack is a dashed outline the whole time, and the caption says what it means instead of the picture showing it. Fix: put two rate tags (15-yr and 30-yr) beside the slot and have them pull apart on "how far apart" (9.5 s), with the dashed stack growing to match. Then let it settle at "that week" (13.4 s).
3. **14.0–25.8 s, about 12 s of dead picture.** "Hard to get back" is only a fourth caption line. The fallback (23.3 s) never appears, and the frames at 18 s and 23 s are almost identical. Fix: have a coin drop into the third house and hit a locked door on "hard to get back" (19.4 s). Bring the fallback object up on "fallback" (23.3 s).
4. **Whole scene, layout.** The four-line caption block in the top right pulls the eye away from the slot. Only the first line of the stack caption has a leader line. Leo's beam is cut off at the left edge. "ILLUSTRATIVE" appears three times. Fix: dolly right so the third slot is centre frame and Leo is cropped out. Put a short tag next to each object instead of the block.

**S32 (10.3 s)**
Scores: emotion/story 2 · understood with sound off 3 · pacing 3 · composition 2

1. **1.03 s, density.** The card has a title plus 9 lines (about 70 words) instead of 6 short lines, and no one can read that in 10 s. Fix: cut it to 6 lines of 6 words or fewer and leave the detail for the description.
2. **0–10 s, the scene shows through.** Leo's beam and the Leo and Tessa labels poke out under the bottom edge of the card. Fix: give the card an opaque background, or dim the whole scene to black behind it.
3. **5.0 s, emphasis in the wrong place.** On "US only" and "history" the underlines appear on the bottom strip, not on the card. Fix: brighten the matching line on the card at 4.6 s and 5.6 s, as already happens with "Not advice" at 9.24 s, and remove the bottom strip while the card is up.
4. **0.3 s, title doesn't match the narration.** The card says "How we know this" while the narration says "what this leaves out." Fix: change the title to "What this leaves out" so it matches the voice-over at 0.3 s.
